verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an AI inference API platform. A buyer could reasonably ask whether such a platform lets them store and manage automations, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no versioning, review, or rollback of automations or workflows. The only versioning evidence covers tracking fine-tuned model versions on dedicated endpoints, which is a related but different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
